rows.name: Access Psionic Talent
rows.description: You are able to manifest minor psionic abilities; gain %1 psionic talents.|max(5,BonusPsionicTalents)

rows.name: Additional Terror
rows.description: You gain an additional terror.

rows.name: Advanced Archer Path
rows.description: You gain +%1 to your damage rolls for attacks made with ranged or thrown weapons.  In addition, when using the Archer maneuver, you may perform a bull rush attempt instead of a trip attempt.|AdvancedArcherPathBonus

rows.name: Advanced Ascetic Path
rows.description: You gain +%1 competence bonus to both AC and saves.  In addition, when using the Ascetic maneuver, you can deflect one attack as if using the Deflect Arrows feat, although you may alternately deflect a melee attack.|AdvancedAsceticPathBonus

rows.name: Advanced Assassin Path
rows.description: When using the Assassin trance, you deal sneak attack as a rogue of half your psychic warrior level.  Your target must be eligible for sneak attack.  In addition, when using the Assassin maneuver, your opponent is staggered for %1 rounds (Fort DC %2 negates).|AdvancedAssassinPathDuration|AdvancedAssassinPathDC

rows.name: Advanced Brawling Path
rows.description: When using the Brawling trance, you gain a +%1 to your grapple checks.  In addition, when using the Brawling maneuver, the damage you deal can be lethal, instead of non-lethal.|AdvancedBrawlingPathBonus

rows.name: Advanced Constructs
rows.description: You gain additional menu options for astral constructs.

rows.name: Advanced Dervish Path
rows.description: When using the Dervish trance, you gain a +%1 competence bonus to your damage rolls.  In addition, you can use the Dervish maneuver even if you moved before your attack and you have no limit of how many 5-foot steps you can take while using the Dervish maneuver, as long as you make at least one attack before each 5-foot step.  The maximum distance you can move in this round is that of a double move.|AdvancedDervishPathBonus

rows.name: Advanced Feral Path
rows.description: When using the Feral trance, you gain a +%1 competence bonus to your damage rolls from natural attacks.  In addition, when using the Feral maneuver, if two natural attacks in the same charge are successful, your natural weapon deal extra damage equal to the damage dealt by one natural attack plus 1-1/2 times your Strength modifier (if the two natural addacks deal different amounts of damage, use the lesser of the two).|AdvancedFeralPathBonus

rows.name: Advanced Infiltrator Path
rows.description: When using the Infiltrator trance, you gain a +%1 competence bonus to Bluff and Sense Motive checks.  In addition, when using the Infiltrator maneuver, for the duration of your metamorphosis power, you gain the scent extraordinary ability and +%1 to Survival checks.|AdvancedInfiltratorPathBonus

rows.name: Advanced Interceptor Path
rows.description: When using the Interceptor trance, you can take a -%1 penalty to Armor Class to grant a deflection bonus to Armor Class to one ally threatened by an enemy within your melee reach.  In addition, when using the Interceptor maneuver, if your attack was successful, you can make a free disarm or trip attempt against the enemy struck.|AdvancedInterceptorPathBonus

rows.name: Advanced Mind Knight Path
rows.description: As long as you have both Mind Knight path powers, you can manifest both Mind Knight path powers at the same time as a single standard action.  Any time you manifest call weaponry, you may select one other 1st level power you know; you may manifest that power using Martial Power as if it were a Path power, as long as the attack is made using the weapon summoned.  In addition, when using the Mind Knight maneuver, you gain a +%1 compteence bonus on the attack rolls.|AdvancedMindKnightPathBonus

rows.name: Advanced Survivor Path
rows.description: When using the Survivor trance, you gain %1 resistance to your active energy type.  In addition, when using the Survivor maneuver, the bonus to Will saves can instead apply to Fortitude saves.|AdvancedSurvivorPathResistance

rows.name: Advanced Weaponmaster Path
rows.description: When using the Weaponmaster trance, you gain a +%1 competence bonus to damage rolls made with a weapon.  In addition, when using the Weaponmaster maneuver, you can choose to make a free disarm attempt against your attacker in place of the single melee attack.  If the disarm is successful, you may then make a single melee attack against your opponent in place of the 5-foot step.|AdvancedWeaponmasterPathBonus

rows.name: Aligned Attack (Chaos)
rows.description: Your attacks gain alignment

rows.name: Aligned Attack (Evil)
rows.description: Your attacks gain alignment

rows.name: Aligned Attack (Good)
rows.description: Your attacks gain alignment

rows.name: Aligned Attack (Law)
rows.description: Your attacks gain alignment

rows.name: Assassin's Shot
rows.description: Once per round when making a successful ranged attack that deals sneak attack damage, you can activate any one style ability that requires expending your psionic focus without having to expend your psionic focus.

rows.name: Assassin's Venom
rows.description: You gain a bonus on the save DC of prevenom or prevenom weapon equal to the competence bonus granted by your trance class feature.

rows.name: Autonomous
rows.description: +2 on Autohypnosis and Knowledge (Psionics) checks

rows.name: Body Fuel
rows.description: Take ability burn to recover power points

rows.name: Boost Construct
rows.description: Astral construct gains additional ability

rows.name: Broken Dreams Style
rows.description: When performing an unarmed attack, you can choose to also deliver your devastating touch damage through that attack.

rows.name: Burning Power
rows.description: Do extra damage with acid or fire power.

rows.name: Burrowing Power
rows.description: Bypass barrier with power

rows.name: Chain Power
rows.description: Choose additional targets with power

rows.name: Channel Rage
rows.description: When you choose to power a manifestation with only your wild surge, you may spend 1 round of your rage instead of expending your psionic focus.

rows.name: Cloak Dance
rows.description: Gain concealment as a move action, total concealment as a full-round action

rows.name: Combat Manifestation
rows.description: +4 bonus on concentration checks for defensive manifesting

rows.name: Concussive Power
rows.description: Disorient with sonic power.

rows.name: Craft Crystalline Focus
rows.description: You can craft crystalline focus items that harness psionic energy such as that for a mind blade, mind armor, or astral suit.

rows.name: Craft Cognizance Crystal
rows.description: Create congnizance crystals

rows.name: Crippling Assault
rows.description: You can paralyze targets of your ranged attacks.

rows.name: Critical Refocus
rows.description: When you confirm a critical hit on an attack where you expended your psionic focus, you automatically regain psionic focus after the results of the attack are determined.

rows.name: Cushion the Blow
rows.description: As long as you are maintaining psoinic focus, as an immediate action, you can minimize the damage of a single attack with a ranged, melee, or natural weapon or unarmed strike (treat all dice rolled as 1s) on any member of the collective.  This ability must be used in response to an attack on a member of the collective.  In addition, if you expend your psionic focus, you can reduce any additional damage on the attack (such as bonus damage from a high Strength or sneak attack damage) by your key ability modifier.

rows.name: Dazing Power
rows.description: Daze creatures with power.

rows.name: Deadly Throw
rows.description: You can replace power with finesse for thrown weapons.

rows.name: Deep Focus
rows.description: You can psionically focus your subconscious in the same manner in which you gain psionic focus normally.  You cannot benefit from both Psicrystal Containment and Deep Focus at the same time.

rows.name: Deep Impact
rows.description: Resolve melee attack as a touch attack

rows.name: Defensive Tactics
rows.description: You add your levels of tactician and fighter together for purposes of your tactics and armor training class features.

rows.name: Delay Power
rows.description: Delay effect of power up to 5 rounds

rows.name: Disciple of Fear
rows.description: For the purpose of your devastating touch and terror class features, your effective class level increases by 4.  This benefit can't increase your effective class level to higher than your Hit Dice.  This feat does not affect your terrors known or give you further uses of your terrors, but increases it for the purposes of augmentation and save DCs.

rows.name: Dispelling Static
rows.description: If you make a successful targeted dispel check, you may choose to have the effect unravel violently, lashing the target of the dispel with psychic static that imposes a -1 penalty on saves against any power you manifest until the end of your next turn. The penalty increases by 1 for each effect dispelled. The target also loses any psionic focus it has and cannot regain psionic focus for 1 round.  This does not affect psionic focus contained in psicrystals via Psicrystal Containment, unless the psicrystal is the target of the targeted dispel attempt.

rows.name: Echoing Power
rows.description: Manifest this power a second time for free.

rows.name: Ectoplasmic Power
rows.description: Power has full effect on incorporeal or ethereal creatures.

rows.name: Efficient Aid
rows.description: Request aid heals 4 hit points per power point.

rows.name: Elemental Blast
rows.description: Your surge blast deals damage of your active energy type instead of force damage.  In addition, your surge blast is modified based upon your active energy type.  Cold: A surge blast of this energy type deals +1 point of damage per die.  Electricity: A surge blast of this energy type provides a +3 bonus on your attack roll if the target is wearing metal armor.  Fire: A surge blast of this energy type deals +1 point of damage per die.  Sonic: A surge blast of this energy type deals -1 point of damage per die and ignores an object's hardness.

rows.name: Empower Power
rows.description: Increase power's variable, numeric effects by 50%%

rows.name: Empowered Shot
rows.description: You can send your ranged attacks farther.

rows.name: Endowed Mind
rows.description: Increase power's save DC for augmentation

rows.name: Enervation Fortitude
rows.description: When you suffer psychic enervation, the penalties are calculated as if your wilder level were reduced by half (to a minimum of 1). [Not figured into the surge description.]

rows.name: Enhanced Steal Life
rows.description: Increase save of Steal Life by spending power points, DC +1/3 points spent.

rows.name: Enlarge Power
rows.description: Double power's range

rows.name: Enlarged Collective
rows.description: The range of your collective is increased.

rows.name: Expanded Collective
rows.description: Add two more creatures to collective.

rows.name: Expanded Favored Weapon
rows.description: You get an extra favored weapon group.

rows.name: Expanded Knowledge
rows.description: Learn an additional power

rows.name: Expanded Martial Power
rows.description: Expend your focus to use any power you know when using your martial power ability, as long as it is at least one level lower than the highest level power you can manifest.

rows.name: Expanded Strategies
rows.description: Gain an additional strategy.

rows.name: Expansive Collective
rows.description: When calculating the range and number of creatures which may be joined to your collective, use your total Hit Dice instead of your class level.

rows.name: Explosive Power
rows.description: Direct targeting powers that deal hit point damage deals damage to all creatures adjacent to target (Reflex half).

rows.name: Extra Blade Skill
rows.description: Gain an extra blade skill.

rows.name: Extend Power
rows.description: Double power's duration

rows.name: Extended Blast
rows.description: Increase surge blast range to 60 feet

rows.name: Extra Customization
rows.description: Gain an additional customization.

rows.name: Extra Disruption Type
rows.description: When you gain psionic focus, you can select one additional creature type as your active type.

rows.name: Extra Insight
rows.description: You gain one additional insight.

rows.name: Extra Power Known
rows.description: Learn an additional power from your class list.

rows.name: Extra Reconfiguration
rows.description: You gain one more use of reconfigure.

rows.name: Extra Strategy
rows.description: You gain two additional uses of your strategy class feature.

rows.name: Extra Terrors
rows.description: You gain 3 additional daily uses of your terrors.

rows.name: Extra Transfer
rows.description: You can use transfer wounds or sickening touch 2 more times per day.  If you have both transfer wounds and sickening touch, choose which ability this feat affects when you take this feat.

rows.name: Fast Aid
rows.description: Your allies may request aid as a swift action.

rows.name: Fast Step
rows.description: You may use Nomad's Step as a move action.

rows.name: Favored Energy (Cold)
rows.description: Any time you manifest a power that deals cold damage, the damage is increased by +1 per die.
rows.pretext: Able to manifest any power that deals cold damage.

rows.name: Favored Energy (Electricity)
rows.description: Any time you manifest a power that deals electricity damage, the damage is increased by +1 per die.
rows.pretext: Able to manifest any power that deals electricity damage.

rows.name: Favored Energy (Fire)
rows.description: Any time you manifest a power that deals fire damage, the damage is increased by +1 per die.
rows.pretext: Able to manifest any power that deals fire damage.

rows.name: Favored Energy (Sonic)
rows.description: Any time you manifest a power that deals sonic damage, the damage is increased by +1 per die.
rows.pretext: Able to manifest any power that deals sonic damage.

rows.name: Fear Mastery
rows.description: As long as you maintain psionic focus, you receive a +1 insight bonus to the save DCs of all your terrors and powers with the Fear descriptor.  You can expend your focus while manifesting a power or using a terror to increase this bonus to +2.

rows.name: Fear's Reach
rows.description: Your devastating touch ability may now be used as a ranged touch attack with a range of close (%1 ft.).|FearsReachRange

rows.name: Fell Shot
rows.description: Resolve ranged attack as a touch attack

rows.name: Flaring Power
rows.description: Dazzle creatures with fire, light, or electricity power.

rows.name: Fighter's Blade
rows.description: Treat your class level as four higher to determine your enhanced mind blade class feature and which blade skills you can select, to a maximum of your character level.

rows.name: Focused Power
rows.description: One target power must overcome higher DC.

rows.name: Focused Precision
rows.description: While maintaining focus, you add your Dexterity modifier to damage rolls made with a crossbow or firearm for which you have the Weapon Focus feat.  Damage from this feat is precision-based damage. [NOT IMPLEMENTED]

rows.name: Focused Sunder
rows.description: Ignore 1/2 hardness of foe's weapon

rows.name: Ghost Attack
rows.description: Reduce damage penalty for attacking incorporeal enemies

rows.name: Gravitic Stability
rows.description: Any time your movement speed would be reduced to 10 ft. as a result of using personal gravity or scorn earth (such as from wearing heavy armor or being more than 1 ft. away from a stable surface), your speed is instead reduced to 10 ft. plus any bonuses to your movement (such as from freerunning). You do not take any penalty for attacking while using scorn earth at distances greater than 1 ft. from the ground or a stable surface. You gain a bonus to your CMD equal to your elocater class level against any bull rush or trip attempt.

rows.name: Greater Cushion the Blow
rows.description: When using the Cushion the Blow feat, the effect applies to all damage for that collective member until the beginning of your next turn.

rows.name: Greater Intuitive Shot
rows.description: Expend focus to gain +%1 damage per attack on full attack with ranged weapon.|WIS

rows.name: Greater Power Penetration
rows.description: Gain bonus to overcome power resistance

rows.name: Greater Power Specialization
rows.description: Increased bonus damage to damaging powers

rows.name: Greater Psionic Endowment
rows.description: Add +2 to power's save DC

rows.name: Greater Psionic Fist
rows.description: Unarmed attack or natural weapon deals extra damage

rows.name: Greater Psionic Shot
rows.description: Ranged weapon deals extra damage

rows.name: Greater Psionic Weapon
rows.description: Melee weapon deals extra damage

rows.name: Harmonic Resonance
rows.description: You can choose %1 powers from your collective members when you choose powers.|max(INT,WIS,CHA)

rows.name: Hawkeye
rows.description: Gain +%1 on Perception; increase precision damage range by %2 ft.|if(skillinfo("RANK","Perception")>=10,4,2)|if(skillinfo("RANK","Perception")>=10,30,15)

rows.name: Hustle Power
rows.description: Manifest a power as a move action instead of a standard action.

rows.name: Improved Cover Fire
rows.description: You gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls to activate your cover fire class feature and the Reflex save DC increases by 1. When you confirm a critical hit when using your cover fire ability, you can expend your psionic focus as an immediate action; if you do and the opponent fails their Reflex save, they are stunned for one round instead of staggered. You must choose to use this ability before the Reflex save and critical confirmation roll.

rows.name: Improved Cushion the Blow
rows.description: When using the Cushion the Blow feat, the effect can be applied to an additional attack with a melee, ranged, or natural weapon in the same round.

rows.name: Improved Disengage
rows.description: When you expend your psionic focus to activate your disengage class feature, you may move 5 feet as a free action that does not provoke an attack of opportunity. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity and does not count as a 5-foot step. You may only use this ability when leaving a threatened square.

rows.name: Improved Disruption
rows.description: Your disrupt pattern ability deals one additional point of damage per die of damage.

rows.name: Improved Metamorphosis
rows.description: Gain one additional menu option from metamorphosis-type power.

rows.name: Improved Psi-Like Ability
rows.description: Choose one psi-like ability gained from your race.  You can use that racial psi-like ability an additional two times per day. [Not implemented.]

rows.name: Improved Psicrystal
rows.description: Enhance your psicrystal

rows.name: Inquisitor
rows.description: +10 on Sense Motive checks to oppose Bluff

rows.name: Insightful Terror
rows.description: As a standard action you can make an Intimidate check to demoralize a single foe (within 30 ft).  If you succeed,the target is paralzed for one round.  This is a mind-affecting fear effect.

rows.name: Intimidating Shot
rows.description: Gain demoralize check on standard action to attack enemy.

rows.name: Intuitive Fighting
rows.description: To use this feat you must maintain psionic focus.  You add your Wisdom modifier to your melee attack rolls instead of your Strength modifier.

rows.name: Intuitive Shot
rows.description: When focused, use a standard action to gain +%1 damage on a ranged weapon attack within 30 ft.|WIS

rows.name: Killer's Vitality
rows.description: Any time you make a successful sneak attack against a living creature, you can expend your psionic focus to gain 3 temporary hit points per die of sneak attack dealt. You can divide these temporary hit points between yourself and members of your collective in any ratio. Special:If your attack reduces the target to fewer than 0 hit points, you gain double the temporary hit points.

rows.name: Knightmare
rows.description: Your manifester level which granted you the terrors class feature gains a +2 bonus as long as this bonus doesn't raise your manifester level above your current Hit Dice. [ML bonus not implemented.] In addition, for the purpose of terrors level requirements and order benefits, add your dread and cavalier levels together. In addition, when declaring your challenge, you can make a free Intimidate check against the target.

rows.name: Knockdown Shot
rows.description: Expend focus to damage and knock prone opponent with ranged attack.

rows.name: Levitative Transport
rows.description: Share elocater movement abilities.

rows.name: Lingering Power
rows.description: Instantaneous power persists for a round.

rows.name: Malleable Power
rows.description: You can exclude areas from power effect.

rows.name: Master of All Forms
rows.description: Manifest shapechanging powers as a swift action

rows.name: Master's Refuge
rows.description: Transfer mind to thrall on death

rows.name: Master's Voice
rows.description: Have permanent mental contact with thralls

rows.name: Maximize Power
rows.description: Maximize power's variable, numeric effects

rows.name: Mental Leap
rows.description: +10 on Acrobatics checks to jump

rows.name: Merciful Power
rows.description: Power does nonlethal damage.

rows.name: Merge Designs
rows.description: Your attoos cannot be interpreted to determine your powers known. In addition, you can safely wear one additional psionic tattoo on your body.  Normal: Tattoos for the pattern designs class feature can be identified by a Spellcraft check.  A character can only safely wear twenty psionic tattoos.

rows.name: Metapsionic Mastery
rows.description: You can apply metapsionic feats to chosen power by increasing cost but not expending focus.

rows.name: Mind Blade Knight
rows.description: Add weapon special abilities to summoned weapons.

rows.name: Mind Knight's Arsenal
rows.description: When you summon a weapon with the call weaponry path power with which you have the Weapon Focus feat, the weapon's enhancement bonus is increased by 1 and it gains a single predetermined weapon special ability with a +1 base price modifier. The weapon special ability must be appropriate for the weapon you choose and must be selected from those weapon special abilities available to the soulknife. You can meditate for 8 hours to change which predetermined special ability it gets.

rows.name: Mind Over Body
rows.description: Heal ability damage more quickly

rows.name: Mixed Combat
rows.description: You are trained in using ranged and melee attacks at the same time.

rows.name: Modified Blast
rows.description: When you activate your surge blast, you gain the following augment options.  Like augmenting a power, augmenting a surge blast is limited to your manifester level.  You can also choose to invoke a wild surge when using your surge blast, using the power from the wild surge to pay for augments to the surge blast, but suffer the standard risk of psychic enervation for invoking a wild surge.  Augment: You can augment your surge blast in one of the following ways.  1. If you spend 2 additional power points, your surge blast deals splash damage.  2. If you spend 3 additional power points, your surge blast is instead a 5 ft. emanation centered on you and cratures in the affected area gain a Reflex save (DC %1) to take half damage.  3. If you spend 4 additional power points, your surge blast deals half damage, but damages all creatures in a 30 ft. line.  4. If you spend 4 additional power points, your surge blast is empowered, dealing 50%% additional damage.  5. If you spend 4 additional power points, your surge blast is a 15 ft. cone effect instead of a ranged touch attack, and creatures in the affected area gain a Reflex save (DC %1) to take half damage.  6.  If you spend 4 additional power points, your surge blast affects all creatures within a 10 ft. radius of the targeted creature and creatures in the affected area gain a Reflex save (DC %1) to take half damage.  7. If you spend 6 additional power points, your surge blast is instead a 10 ft. emanation centered on you and creatures in the affected area gain a Reflex save (DC %1) to take half damage.|ModifiedBlastDC

rows.name: Multiple Connections
rows.description: You can be attuned to up to three creatures for the purposes of Open Door.

rows.name: Nightmare Veil
rows.description: While in broken dreams style, any target that is shaken treats you as concealed.  In addition, while in the broken dreams style, you treat shaken targets as flat-footed for unarmed attacks.

rows.name: Nomad's Jump
rows.description: Your levels of elocater stack with your levels of nomad for the purposes of determining the range of nomad's step. In addition, when you use nomad's step, you may split your distance traveled into two steps and determine your line of sight at the end of the first step. The total distance traveled must not exceed your maximum range for nomad's step and you may perform no other actions during the steps.

rows.name: One Pattern
rows.description: Your target no longer needs to match your active creature type to deal full damage with your disrupt pattern ability. If your target does match your active creature type, you inflict an extra 1 point of damage per dice of damage dealt with disrupt pattern. This extra damage is not multiplied on a critical hit.

rows.name: Open Door
rows.description: Once an individual has failed a Will save to avoid being mindlocked by you, you can attune yourself to that creature.  You can reactivate the mindlock to an attuned creature at any time by spending 1 power point as a free action, regardless of the time since you first mindlocked the target.  This means they count as having failed their Will save.  Maximum number of attunements:%1|OpenDoorAttunements

rows.name: Open Minded
rows.description: Gain skill points

rows.name: Opportunity Power
rows.description: Make attacks of opportunity with touch powers

rows.name: Overchannel
rows.description: Take damage to increase your manifester level

rows.name: Penetrating Fear
rows.description: You can expend your psionic focus when activating a terror to allow it to affect those normally immune to fear effects or mind-affecting effects.  The target gets a +4 bonus to any applicable save against the effect.

rows.name: Persistent Focus
rows.description: Choose one psionic ability or psionic feat that requires maintaining psionic focus. From this point forward, you are always considered psionically focused even if you expend your psionic focus for any other ability.

rows.name: Persistent Power
rows.description: Target of power must make two saves.

rows.name: Piercing Power
rows.description: Power affects target as if target had 5 smaller SR.

rows.name: Piranha Strike
rows.description: You make a combination of quick strikes, sacrificing accuracy for multiple, minor wounds that prove exceptionally deadly.
rows.benefit: When wielding a light weapon, you can choose to take a -%1 penalty on all melee attack rolls and combat maneuver checks to gain a +%2 bonus on all melee damage rolls.  This bonus damage is halved (-50%%) if you are making an attack with an off-hand weapon or secondary natural weapon.  You must choose to use this feat before the attack roll, and its effects last until your next turn.  The bonus damage does not apply to touch attacks or effects that do not deal hit point damage.  This feat cannot be used in conjunction with the Power Attack feat.|PiranhaStrikeAttackPenalty|PiranhaStrikeBonusDamage

rows.name: Power Channeler
rows.description: You can channel a touch range power through a melee weapon.  You can make a single melee attack during the same action in which you manifest a touch power with a manifesting time of one standard action; if this melee attack hits, it triggers the power as if you had succeeded on a touch attack and deals damage as normal.  If you miss, the power fizzles and the charge is lost.  This attack is made against standard AC and not touch AC.

rows.name: Power Penetration
rows.description: Gain bonus to overcome power resistance

rows.name: Power Perfection
rows.description: Pick one power which you have the ability to manifest. Whenever you manifest that power you may apply any one metapsionic feat you have to that power without expending psionic focus or affecting its level or manifesting time, as long as the total power point cost of the power, including the metapsionic feat cost and any augmentation, does not exceed 17 power points. In addition, if you have other feats which allow you to apply a set numerical bonus to any aspect of this power (such as Power Penetration, Psionic Endowment, Weapon Focus [ray], and so on), double the bonus granted by that feat when applied to this power.

rows.name: Power Specialization
rows.description: Gain bonus damage to damaging powers

rows.name: Psicrystal Affinity
rows.description: Obtain a psicrystal

rows.name: Psicrystal Containment
rows.description: Your psicrystal can hold a psionic focus

rows.name: Psionic Body
rows.description: +2 hit points for each psionic feat you have

rows.name: Psionic Bull Rush
rows.description: While maintaining psionic focus, when you successfully perform a bull rush maneuver, you also deal %1 damage to the creature bull rushed.  If you expend your psoinic focus when you successfully make a bull rush maneuver, you can also knock the target of your bull rush prone.|PsionicBullRushDamage

rows.name: Psionic Charge
rows.description: Charge while taking erratic course to foe

rows.name: Psionic Critical
rows.description: While maintaining psionic focus, when you successfully score a critical hit, you deal +1d8 bonus damage.  If you expend your psionic focus, you deal an additional +1d8 bonus damage.

rows.name: Psionic Disarm
rows.description: While maintaining psionic focus, when you successfully perform a disarm combat maneuver, you also deal %1 damage to the creature disarmed.  If you expend your psionic focus when you make a successful disarm combat maneuver, you can also send the disarmed object into any space of your choosing within %2 ft.  If a creature is in the selected space and has a hand free, it can grab the disarmed object as an immediate action.|PsionicDisarmDamage|PsionicDisarmDistance

rows.name: Psionic Dodge
rows.description: +1 dodge bonus to AC

rows.name: Psionic Endowment
rows.description: Add +1 to power's save DC

rows.name: Psionic Fist
rows.description: Unarmed attack or natural weapon deals extra damage

rows.name: Psionic Meditation
rows.description: Become psionically focused as a move action

rows.name: Psionic Overrun
rows.description: While maintaining psionic focus, when you successfully perform an overrun combat maneuver, you also deal %1 damage.  If you expend your psionic focus when you perform a successful overrun combat maneuver, you can also push your target up to %2 feet.|PsionicOverrunDamage|PsionicOverrunDistance

rows.name: Psionic Precise Shot
rows.description: To use this feat, you must expend your psionic focus.  You can attempt to make a single ranged attack as a standard action against a target that is sheltered behind a wall, wall of force effect, or similar barrier.  Your attack briefly skips through the Astral Plane to bypass the barrier.  You must still have line of sight to the target.

rows.name: Psionic Shield Bash
rows.description: While maintaining psionic focus, when you successfully strike a foe with a shield bash attack, the foe is shaken for 1 round (Will DC %1 negates).  This is a mind-affecting fear effect.  If you expend your psionic focus when you make a shield bash, on a successful attack roll you can instead force the target to make a Will saving throw or be stunned for 1 round.|PsionicShieldBashDC

rows.name: Psionic Shot
rows.description: Ranged weapon deals extra damage
rows.benefit: While you maintain psionic focus, your attacks with a ranged weapon deal an extra 1 point of damage. Additionally, if you expend your psionic focus as part of an attack with a ranged weapon, that attack instead deals an extra 2d6 points of damage. You must decide whether or not to use this feat prior to making an attack. If your attack misses, you still expend your psionic focus.

rows.name: Psionic Stamina
rows.description: As long as you maintain psionic focus, you gain a +1 bonus to your Fortitude saves for each psionic feat you have (including this one), to a maximum bonus of 1/3 of your soulknife class level (rounded down, minimum +1). You can expend your psionic focus as an immediate action to also add your Wisdom bonus to your Fortitude saves instead of your Constitution bonus until the beginning of your next turn.

rows.name: Psionic Sunder
rows.description: While maintaining psionic focus, when you successfully perform a sunder combat maneuver, you also deal %1 damage to the creature holding the item sundered.  If you expend your psionic focus when you perform a successful sunder maneuver, you ignore half the hardness of the object you are sundering.|PsionicSunderDamage

rows.name: Psionic Talent
rows.description: Gain additional power points

rows.name: Psionic Trip
rows.description: While maintaining psionic focus, when you successfully perform a trip combat maneuver, you also deal %1 damage to the creature tripped.  If you expend your psionic focus when you perform a successful trip combat maneuver, you can also throw your target up to %2 ft., although the creature thrown may not be more than one size category larger than you.|PsionicTripDamage|PsionicTripDistance

rows.name: Psionic Unarmed Strike
rows.description: To use this feat, you must expend psionic focus.  You can attempt to make a single unarmed melee attack as a standard action against a target that is sheltered behind a wall, wall of force effect, or similar barrier.  Your attack briefly skips through the Astral Plane to bypass the barrier.  This does not grant you line of sight or extra reach, requiring you to make the attack without being able to see the target or use some other method of seeing the target (such as clairaudience/clairvoyance) and be within your normal reach for your unarmed attack.

rows.name: Psionic Weapon
rows.description: Melee weapons deal extra damage

rows.name: Psychoportive Pathfinder
rows.description: Any time you manifest psychoport, you may, as a free action, choose to leave a marker for someone else to follow. This marker has a duration of one round. If another person casts teleport or greater teleport or manifests psychoport or greater psychoport in the space you left from, they can choose as part of casting the spell or manifesting the power to appear adjacent to you in a safe, uninhabited space even if they would normally fail due to lack of familiarity or lack of range.

rows.name: Pyromaniac
rows.description: Add your alchemist and pyrokineticist levels together to determine the damage done by your bombs and the number of bombs you can create each day. Additionally, when you apply your weapon afire ability to your bombs, all creatures in the splash area also take the extra damage from your weapon afire ability.

rows.name: Quick Suit
rows.description: You can form your astral suit as a free action once per turn.

rows.name: Quicken Power
rows.description: Manifest powers as a swift action

rows.name: Raging Hulk
rows.description: For the purpose of level requirements for rage powers or astral suit customizations, add your levels of barbarian and aegis together. Damage reduction from either class stacks. In addition, any time you enter a rage, you can activate augment suit as a free action.

rows.name: Rapid Augmentation
rows.description: You can activate your augment suit class feature as a swift action.

rows.name: Rapid Draw
rows.description: You may form your mind blade as a free action an additional %1 times per round.|RapidDrawExtraRounds

rows.name: Rapid Metabolism
rows.description: Heal hit points more quickly

rows.name: Ready Response
rows.description: At the beginning of a surprise round, if you would not normally take an action, you can expend your psionic focus to roll initiative and take a standard action or a move action.  If you do move normally in a surprise round, you can expend your psionic focus to take a full-round of action, rather than only a standard or move action.

rows.name: Rebounding Throw
rows.description: Expend focus when thrown weapon hits to attack another enemy.

rows.name: Reckless Offense
rows.description: Take -4 to AC to gain +2 melee attack bonus

rows.name: Redirect Power
rows.description: You can redirect a failed power to a different target.

rows.name: Resonance Mastery
rows.description: Apply metapsionic feats to powers without paying increased cost but by increasing manifesting time

rows.name: Return Shot
rows.description: Deflect range attacks back at attacker

rows.name: Returning Throw
rows.description: Thrown weapons return to your hand.

rows.name: Ricochet
rows.description: Expend focus to redirect thrown attacks; %1 redirections per attack.|1+WIS

rows.name: Rime Power
rows.description: Entangle creatures with cold power.

rows.name: Scholarly Discipline
rows.description: Your psion manifester level and wizard caster level gain a +2 bonus as long as this bonus doesn't raise your manifester level or caster level above your current Hit Dice. [NOT IMPLEMENTED]

rows.name: Scribe Tattoo
rows.description: Create psionic tattoos

rows.name: Selective Power
rows.description: Choose %1 targets to exclude from power.|SelectivePowerTargets

rows.name: Shared Power
rows.description: Manifest personal power as a 30-ft. ray, or with the Network descriptor.

rows.name: Shattered Dream Strike
rows.description: While in the broken dreams style, after making a successful unarmed strike empowered with your devastating touch, you can make a free Intimidate check against the target.

rows.name: Sickening Power
rows.description: Sicken creatures with power.

rows.name: Sidestep Charge
rows.description: +4 bonus to AC against a charging foe

rows.name: Soul Warrior
rows.description: Your manifester level which granted you the warrior's path class feature gains a +2 bonus as long as this bonus doesn't raise your manifester level above your current Hit Dice. Your soulknife level gains a +2 bonus, up to a maximum of your hit dice, for the purpose of your mind blade enhancement class feature. In addition, any time you perform a path maneuver while wielding your mind blade, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls with your mind blade for until the end of your next turn.

rows.name: Speed of Thought
rows.description: +10 feet to speed in light or medium armor

rows.name: Split Headed Lash
rows.description: Expend focus to split one fire lash attack from a full attack into two attacks.

rows.name: Split Psionic Ray
rows.description: Split one ray attack into two

rows.name: Staggering Shot
rows.description: Stagger hampered enemy with a ranged attack.

rows.name: Student of the Astral Suit
rows.description: Treat your class level as four higher to determine your number of customization points and which customizations you can select for your astral suit, to a maximum of your character level.

rows.name: Surging Aura
rows.description: Wild surge grants bonus to allies

rows.name: Swift Shapeshifter
rows.description: Manifest shapechanging powers more quickly

rows.name: Talented
rows.description: Take no damage from overchanneling some powers

rows.name: Telepathic Link
rows.description: Gain ability to link creatures together to communicate telepathically

rows.name: Terror Mastery
rows.description: When you use your terrors class feature, you can activate two terrors in a single swift action.

rows.name: Thundering Power
rows.description: Deafen creatures with damaging power.

rows.name: Tomb Raider
rows.description: Add your levels of cryptic and ranger together for the purposes of your trapfinding and favored terrain class features. In addition, you can add your favored terrain (underground) bonus to Disable Device checks when in an underground terrain.

rows.name: Toppling Power
rows.description: Knock creatures prone with force power.

rows.name: Touch of Terror
rows.description: Your devastating touch ability deals 1d6 points of damage plus your class level and your Charisma modifier.

rows.name: Toughened Suit
rows.description: Any time you form your astral suit, you can choose to pay 1 power point as part of the action to form the astral suit to gain %1 temporary hit points. These temporary hit points last until your astral suit is dismissed, destroyed, or otherwise ends.|ToughenedSuitTempHP

rows.name: Twin Power
rows.description: Manifest power twice

rows.name: Twin Throw
rows.description: First attack in full-attack with thrown weapons uses two weapons.

rows.name: Unavoidable Strike
rows.description: Resolve unarmed attack or natural weapon attack as a touch attack

rows.name: Unconditional Power
rows.description: Manifest power despite character condition

rows.name: Unlocked Talent
rows.description: You gain 2 power points and one 1st-level power.

rows.name: Unwilling Participant
rows.description: You can attempt to force others into your collective.
rows.benefit: You may attempt to force a living creature into your collective.  The target may attempt a Will save (DC %1) to resist.  If the target fails the save, it may attempt another Will save at the same DC every 24 hours thereafter, but is otherwise unable to leave the collective unless you allow it.  Special: Creatures forced into your collective using Unwilling Participant are considered willing members for any collective-related effects unless they succeed on another Will save at the same DC to resist being forced into the collective.  A successful save means the creature resisted the speciifc effect but is still a member of the collective.|UnwillingParticipantDC

rows.name: Up the Walls
rows.description: Run on walls and ceilings

rows.name: Urban Tracking
rows.description: You can track down the location of missing persons or wanted individuals within communities.
rows.benefit: To find the trail of an individual or to follow it for 1 hour requires a Diplomacy check to gather information. You must make another Diplomacy check every hour of the search, as well as each time the trail becomes difficult to follow, such as when it moves to a different area of town. The DC of the check, and the number of checks required to track down your quarry, depends on the community size and the conditions. If you fail a Diplomacy check, you can retry after 1 hour of questioning. The game master should roll the number of checks required secretly, so that the player doesn't know exactly how long the task will require.&nl; Normal: A character without this feat can use Diplomacy to find out information about a particular individual, but each check takes 1d4+1 hours and doesn't allow effective tailing.

rows.name: Widen Power
rows.description: Double power's area

rows.name: Wildblood Mage
rows.description: Your wilder manifester level gains a +2 bonus as long as this bonus doesn't raise your manifester level above your current Hit Dice. Your sorcerer caster level gains a +2 bonus as long as this bonus doesn't raise your caster level above your current Hit Dice. In addition, you can use your wild surge on spells, increasing your caster level the wild surge amount, and your bloodline arcana is applied to applicable powers. [NOT IMPLEMENTED]

rows.name: Wild Talent
rows.description: Gain psionic ability and 2 power points

rows.name: Wounding Attack
rows.description: Wound opponents with your attack
